text:
Maria (SRE): heads up — seeing a surge of SSE stream truncations out of ap-southeast-1 starting ~2026-03-15T10:22Z. Clients report final chunks missing, some streams just close mid-response. Also multiple customers flagged duplicate billing when clients reconnect quickly.

Samir (Platform Eng): on it. Can you paste last logs and a repro? frequency?

Maria (SRE): ~7% of streamed requests in the window 10:22–10:34Z. Edge logs show a pattern: upstream returns 200 then a FIN soon after, no trailing [DONE] chunk. Example from edge-proxy logs:

```
[2026-03-15T10:23:12.123Z] req_id=abc123 client_ip=203.0.113.45 method=GET path=/v1/stream status=200 bytes_sent=4520 upstream_status=200 upstream_bytes=4520 event=stream_end reason=client_connection_close
[2026-03-15T10:23:12.124Z] proxy: connection reset by peer (errno=104)
```

Maria (SRE): also see occasional 502 from envoy for the same timeframe: `upstream response timeout` but most are 200 then sudden close.

Nina (Support): customer ticket #CS-9821 — they pasted client-side logs: websocket shows EOF and reconnect, then their app retried and got billed twice for overlapping tokens. They included the curl repro:

```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=rw-13b-preview" \
  -d '{"prompt":"long output test","stream":true}'
# reproducible: stream starts, outputs a few data: events then connection closes without data: [DONE]
```

Lee (DevEx): the client retry logic in a lot of SDKs just reconnects and treats new stream as fresh billable work. We need guidance: 1) server should support idempotency via X-Idempotency-Key, 2) SDK should dedupe repeated streams for in-flight request ids.

Samir (Platform Eng): Agree. Short term: we can do two mitigations: 1) route APAC streaming traffic to eu-west gateways to avoid the failing edge pool, 2) enable non-SSE fallback (chunked transfer / polling) for affected customers. Which customers are impacted?

AJ (Customer Success): high-volume customers A and B flagged (enterprise, paying). Several small clients too. We need a rollback plan and a customer-facing note.

Maria (SRE): I'm going to run a quick canary failover of ap-southeast streaming traffic to eu-west. Flipping weights now (will take a minute).

oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-0456 created; priority P1 assigned; paging Maria, Samir, Nina.

(60s later)

Maria (SRE): failover applied at 10:31Z for streaming route only. Early metrics: SSE error rate in ap-southeast dropped from 7.1% -> 0.8% over 2 minutes. Customers reporting immediate improvement.

Samir (Platform Eng): hands-on root cause: new edge runtime image 1.14.2 introduced a keepalive/EOF regression under certain idle write patterns for long-running chunked responses. It causes the TCP FIN to be issued prematurely when response buffer flushes coincide with connection churn. We'll roll back the edge image for streaming handlers.

Maria (SRE): rolling edge image back to 1.14.1 for streaming pools now. ETA ~7 mins.

Lee (DevEx): publishing short-term guidance in #help: recommend SDKs set X-Idempotency-Key per logical request and retry semantics: treat reconnects within 3s as resumable if server returns a resume token; otherwise dedupe. Example header we suggest: `X-Idempotency-Key: <client-generated-uuid>`

Nina (Support): will notify customers A/B and open refund tickets for duplicate charges. Billing flagged potential double-charges — need logs.

Samir (Platform Eng): billing note: duplicate billing occurs when clients reconnect and server accepts both streams as separate billable sessions. We will: 1) add server-side dedupe window keyed by X-Idempotency-Key (short-term 60s) to dedupe token accounting, 2) run a billing reconciliation for the incident window and issue credits.

AJ (Customer Success): please share the list of impacted request IDs so we can proactively reach out.

Maria (SRE): edge rollback to 1.14.1 completed at 10:39Z. Post-rollback metrics show error rate back to baseline. No new truncated streams observed in the last 8 minutes.

Samir (Platform Eng): follow-ups: - deploy hotfix to edge runtime to fix keepalive regression (PR in progress) - add stream healthcheck that validates trailing [DONE] semantics - add per-request idempotency dedupe in the charge pipeline - update SDK docs for idempotency/resume semantics

Lee (DevEx): I'll put a short code snippet in the SDK doc: how to set idempotency-key + simple client-side reconnection logic.

Maria (SRE): mitigation timeline: 10:22Z start, 10:31Z routing failover, 10:39Z edge rollback, 10:48Z incident declared mitigated (monitoring).

oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-0456 status updated -> mitigated. Postmortem assigned to Samir/Maria/Nina.

Samir (Platform Eng): quick repro steps for engineering: 1) run long-streaming prompt that emits ~30s of data; 2) artificially induce small socket write stalls during mid-stream on edge (use tc netem or simulate in proxy); 3) observe premature FIN from edge and truncated stream. Attached test harness snippet:

```
# python example (simplified)
import requests
import time
s = requests.Session()
r = s.post("https://edge-host/v1/stream?model=test", json={"prompt":"lots of text","stream":True}, stream=True)
for chunk in r.iter_content(chunk_size=None):
    print(chunk)
    # simulate client buffering pause
    time.sleep(0.05)
```

Samir (Platform Eng): CI/regression: add integration test using a flaky-proxy that simulates the earlier keepalive pattern.

Nina (Support): Customer comms drafted, will send to AJ for review. Also creating billing refund batch for CS-9821 and similar tickets.

AJ (Customer Success): please include a short technical note and expected credit amounts; customers appreciate transparency. :thumbsup:

Maria (SRE): I'll start the timeline and add relevant logs to the postmortem. Anything else urgent?

Lee (DevEx): once Samir's hotfix is in, let's coordinate a canary and call out the fix in release notes. Also add a short FAQ on 'why did my streaming session end early?'.

Samir (Platform Eng): noted. I'll own the postmortem and the billing reconciliation.

Maria (SRE): closing updates in this thread. If anyone sees residuals, ping oncall. Thanks everyone.
